meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'щение'). Verbal action/result neuter noun formed with '-ение'/'-ание'. Common neuter noun meaning 'forgiveness' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Прошу прощения, никогда о ней не слышал.
examples.trans: I beg your pardon, I have never heard of her.

examples.text: Я прошу прощения.
examples.trans: I apologise.

examples.text: Он просит у меня прощения.
examples.trans: He is asking me to forgive him.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'never', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Прошу прощения, никогда о ней не слышал.
examples.trans: I beg your pardon, I have never heard of her.

examples.text: Я никогда в жизни так не был готов!
examples.trans: I have never been this ready in my life!

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'about', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Да, я внимательно слушаю, Элеонора Андреевна.
examples.trans: Yes, I am listening attentively, Eleonora Andreyevna.

examples.text: Миша, скоро у нас модный показ.
examples.trans: Misha, soon we will have a fashion show.

examples.text: Нам нужно очень хорошо к нему подготовиться.
examples.trans: We need to prepare very well for it.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'лышать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'heard', paired with 'услышать'.

examples.text: Прошу прощения, никогда о ней не слышал.
examples.trans: I beg your pardon, I have never heard of her.

examples.text: Я сама только что всё слышала!
examples.trans: I just heard everything myself!

examples.text: Мы к банкету готовимся, не слышал.
examples.trans: We are preparing for the banquet, I did not hear it.
